title: Cross-toolchain ABI fingerprints
description: The only contract between the generator and its consumers. Compatibility rules, so that data published later still works with consumers written earlier: (1) within a major version, fields are only ever added, never renamed, removed or retyped; (2) consumers must ignore properties they do not know; (3) fields marked with x-known-values are open enums: new values may appear in a minor version, and consumers must treat a value they do not know as unknown; (4) consumers must refuse a major version they do not know. This schema is therefore tolerant (unknown properties and values validate); the generator validates in strict mode, where x-known-values and the listed properties are exhaustive.

generated_at.description: Informational only; consumers must not use it.

version.description: uClibc-ng/musl/glibc release. Display and helper only: version is not ABI.

soname.description: SONAME of the sysroot's own loader. May differ from basename(interp): the classic ld-uClibc.so.1 vs .so.0 trap.

interp.description: PT_INTERP of a dynamically linked probe binary; empty if dynamic linking failed.

isa.description: ISA line from readelf -A on the probe binary; empty if the arch has none.

float_abi.description: From the ELF attributes/flags, not free text: MIPS FP ABI, ARM Tag_ABI_VFP_args / e_flags.

pie_default.description: true if a plain link produces ET_DYN (PIE) by default.

needed.description: NEEDED of a trivial hello program: the minimum any binary needs.

needed_corpus.description: Union of NEEDED over the C probe corpus (pthreads, select/clock_gettime, dlopen, libm, 64-bit division): what real C programs pull in. The C++ corpus program only sets cxx_ok.

sysroot_sonames.description: Every SONAME shipped in the toolchain sysroot.

cxx_ok.description: A C++ compiler is present and linked the corpus program.

hash_style.description: DT_HASH / DT_GNU_HASH in a default dynamic link. Old loaders only read DT_HASH.

time64_syscalls.description: none: only legacy time syscalls. fallback: tries *_time64 (Linux >= 5.1) and falls back on ENOSYS. required: *_time64 only, fails with ENOSYS before Linux 5.1.

headers.description: Sysroot kernel headers version: an upper bound on syscalls the libc may use.

min.description: Minimum kernel the libc enforces at startup (glibc ELF ABI note); empty if none.

requires.description: Highest GLIBC_x.y symbol version the probe corpus needs.

provides.description: Highest GLIBC_x.y the sysroot libc defines.

isa_level.description: From e_flags EF_MIPS_ARCH, e.g. mips32, mips32r2.

nan.description: e_flags EF_MIPS_NAN2008. A mismatch is refused by the kernel/loader.

mips.description: Same content as arch.abi for MIPS; kept for 2.1/2.2 consumers.

arm.description: Same content as arch.abi for ARM; kept for 2.1/2.2 consumers.

arch.description: Architecture-specific ABI facts, decoded from ELF e_flags and attributes. abi is open-ended so that a new architecture needs no schema change: its keys depend on family (mips: isa_level, nan, fp_abi, mips16, micromips; arm: eabi, vfp_args; riscv: float_abi, rvc, rve, tso, isa; power: fp, elf_abi; aarch64/x86_64/x86: none).

family.description: Unrecognized machines get the first word of readelf's Machine, lowercased.

provenance.description: What this record was computed from. A record is current exactly as long as dockerfile_sha256 and probe_version match the repo.

image_digest.description: The image the probe ran in: a pullable registry reference (repo@sha256:...) when it came from a registry, else the local image ID.

probe_version.description: sha256 of generator/probe/ (what runs inside the image).

normalize_version.description: sha256 of generator/normalize.py. When only this changes, records are re-derived from data/raw/ without re-probing.

raw.description: Unnormalized source strings, for debugging only. Consumers must not match on these.

version.description: Dotted version, or empty if unknown.
